info.prompt: A cyberpunk-gothic hybrid casino interior, where neon cyan and electric magenta dice roll across a skeletal gold filigree table, their translucent facets pulsing with internal energy against a void black background, while holographic terminal text scrolls hacker logs across the lower third of the frame, all illuminated by the rhythmic heartbeat of an oscilloscope-style light trail synced to 120 BPM.
